### Pipeline Autonome V5
```
place-de-greve.md (changé)
    ↓
dashboard-watcher.mjs (détecte, debounce 2s)
    ↓
scan-place-de-greve.mjs (auto-prioritize + auto-take)
    ├── backupQueue() → archives/
    ├── validateMissionTable() → rollback si besoin
    ├── idempotenceGuard() → abort si 0 missions
    ├── CLAW.md spawn → projets BMAD + openclaw
    └── dashboard-project-sync.mjs → production-dashboard.md

Health Check (every heartbeat)
    ├── queue_integrity → pass/fail
    ├── scanner → pass/fail
    ├── watcher_process → pass/fail/warn
    ├── recent_activity → pass/fail/warn
    ├── backups → pass/fail/warn
    └── stale_missions → pass/fail/warn
    ↓ logs → health-check.jsonl
```
